root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward fineness, narrowness, or a slender pointed part, exemplified by the pointed fitting of a spear and the narrowness of eyebrows.
root_idea.development: The lexical branches extend from a slender or pointed implement to piercing and thrusting, descriptive terms for narrow or arched eyebrows, and related figurative applications. The glass vocabulary is separately attested as a lexical branch.

qac_form_accounting.reason: A Quran-attested nominal form with a well-supported singular dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: A transparent glass vessel or container; also the glass material from which such vessels are made.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic lamp image, the word denotes the glass vessel or enclosure associated with the lamp.

senses.definition: The glass enclosure or globe of a lamp, understood metonymically in the Quranic lamp image as the lamp itself.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-specific contextual interpretation of the glass in 24:35; it is not a general synonym for every glass vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pierce or thrust with the pointed iron fitting of a spear; to cast at someone with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object used for piercing or throwing is the زُجّ, the pointed iron fitting of the spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast or throw a thing away from oneself or from one's hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of casting or thrusting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ostrich, to run while throwing out its legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied specifically to the ostrich's manner of running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a valley, to put forth herbage as though casting it from itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of vegetation emerging from a valley.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eyebrow, to be or become narrow and long, or narrow and arched.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive descriptive use concerning the form of the eyebrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shape the eyebrows by making them narrow, long, or arched; to trim redundant hair or lengthen their appearance with antimony.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cosmetic or grooming application to the eyebrows; the alternatives describe related methods of producing the stated appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a place even and adjusted; alternatively, to provide it with a زُجّ to hold and protect what is inside.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported for the prepared hole or place in a piece of wood; the two explanations are variant interpretations of the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put or make a زُجّ on a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The زُجّ is the pointed iron fitting attached to the spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove the زُجّ from a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported but disputed interpretation of the Form IV expression; another authority rejects this meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an eyebrow, to reach the outer extremity of the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the extension of the eyebrow toward the eye's outer edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of herbage, for the intervening spaces to become closed up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to vegetation whose growth fills the spaces between it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pointed iron foot, heel, or shoe fixed to the lower end of a spear, used to stick the spear into the ground; by synecdoche, its plural can denote spears generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The iron fitting at the upper end of a spear, used for piercing, is distinguished as a سِنَانٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pointed extremity or joint of the elbow; by extension, the elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative anatomical use based on the pointed extremity of the spear fitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tushes or canine teeth of a stallion camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron pivot around which a millstone turns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported meaning marked as an assumed figurative application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrowhead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also used for the pointed metal head of an arrow, with separately recorded plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Narrowness and length, or narrowness, fullness, and arching, of the eyebrows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The variant descriptions concern the characteristic shape or appearance of the eyebrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ostrich, length of the shanks and breadth of stride.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the ostrich's leg proportions and manner of stepping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, width or wideness in the space between the hind legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the bodily spacing of camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wideness of a solid hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is described as a fault in the hoof.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Darts or javelins furnished with iron heads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun for iron-headed missiles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wild asses fighting one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicographic reading reported in variant copies; the fighting-wild-asses interpretation is the preferred reading in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The berries of the clove tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is associated with the fatḥah-vowelled form زَجَاجٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The art or occupation of making glass or glass vessels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational meaning of a variant of the glass-related noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of glass or glass vessels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun derived from the glass term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A maker or manufacturer of glass or glass vessels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun for a glassmaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare figurative explanation based on the emission of wind and excrement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having narrow, long, full, or arched eyebrows; in a Yemeni dialect, the eyebrow itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person or eyebrow; the naturally occurring eyebrow form is distinguished in the lexical discussion from an artificially produced form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long-legged or long-stepping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to an ostrich, and also to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a male ostrich, having white feathers above the eyes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported descriptive application to the ostrich.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a solid hoof, wide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive application to the hoof, recorded as a figurative extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spear having a زُجّ affixed to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived noun denotes the spear by reference to its fitted lower iron.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A short spear like a مِزْرَاق, fitted with a زُجّ at its lower end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A weapon noun describing the spear and its lower fitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that transfixes or passes through quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A secondary application of the short-spear noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument used to shape the eyebrow into the form described as أَزَجُّ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cosmetic implement for producing a narrow, long, or arched eyebrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pierced or thrust with the زُجّ of a spear; cast at with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of someone or something struck or thrown at with the spear fitting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large bucket whose two opposite lips or edges are brought together and sewn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate noun for a particular construction of bucket.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Glass sense and Quranic lamp-image interpretation represented.
Pointer to the preceding glass entry.

cautions: The Quranic interpretation of the glass as a lamp is a contextual or metonymic reading alongside the literal glass-vessel sense.
The reported meaning of أَزَجَّ as removing a spear's زُجّ is explicitly disputed in the lexical evidence.
